name: GitHub's own MCP server
gain: The team's coding agent can read GitHub directly. No gain measured.
how: claude mcp add github -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=$GITHUB_PAT -- docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server
replaces: Copying from the dashboard by hand.
trade_offs: It holds access to your account, so scope the token.
install: claude mcp add github -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=$GITHUB_PAT -- docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server

gain_model.formula: no money figure: developer time, unmeasured

test_recipe.what_to_compare: a developer tries it on one task

verify_rule: Whether the team keeps it installed after 30 days

change_recipe.how: claude mcp add github -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=$GITHUB_PAT -- docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server
change_recipe.left_off: Never a pull request: a brief line
